story_plan.style_description: an illuminated celestial fresco with deep blue heavens, gold astronomical ornament, stone architecture, luminous thresholds and finely painted human figures
story_plan.composition: tripartite vertical composition: celestial upper register, crowded civic middle register, intimate human lower register; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited; the central focus occupies less than one third of the frame
story_plan.central_subject: a procession of keepers passes sealed objects from hand to hand across generations, preserving an unbroken chain of custody
story_plan.central_action: new evidence is added at the growing end while corrections remain beside older traces instead of replacing them
micro_scenes: an older damaged record remains visible beside its careful correction
a witness seals a bundle before sending it across a bridge
an archivist compares two versions while a third person records the transfer
story_plan.architecture_contract: a monumental complex of gates, chambers, stairways, bridges, sealed passages and deep perspective; extend architecture into every edge and corner with inhabited side galleries, stairs, bridges and distant courts
